# Hindustan Times
> Indian news platform covering breaking news, live updates, politics, world affairs, cricket, entertainment, business, technology, and lifestyle.

Hindustan Times publishes real-time reporting and analysis across national and international news, city coverage, sports, opinion, and feature journalism. Its site also includes topic hubs, live blogs, explainers, photos, videos, and premium editorial content.

## Main News Hubs
- [Homepage](https://www.hindustantimes.com): Front page with top stories, breaking news, live updates, and featured coverage.
- [Latest News](https://www.hindustantimes.com/latest-news): Rolling feed of the newest headlines across politics, world, sports, and entertainment.
- [India News](https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news): National news coverage spanning politics, policy, crime, courts, and public affairs.
- [World News](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news): International reporting on geopolitics, conflicts, diplomacy, and major global developments.
- [Cities](https://www.hindustantimes.com/cities): City-focused reporting from major Indian metros and regional urban centers.
- [Trending](https://www.hindustantimes.com/trending): Viral stories, internet trends, unusual news, and social media-driven coverage.

## India, Politics, and Public Affairs
- [India News](https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news): National affairs, elections, governance, law, and major domestic developments.
- [Education](https://www.hindustantimes.com/education): Exam news, admissions, board results, recruitment, and academic policy updates.
- [Opinion](https://www.hindustantimes.com/opinion): Editorials, columns, commentary, and analysis from writers and guest contributors.
- [HT Insight](https://www.hindustantimes.com/ht-insight): Deeper analysis, explainers, and perspective pieces on current affairs.
- [Photos](https://www.hindustantimes.com/photos): Photo galleries documenting news events, personalities, and visual features.
- [Videos](https://www.hindustantimes.com/videos): News clips, interviews, explainers, and event footage across beats.

## World Coverage
- [World News](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news): Global headlines covering wars, diplomacy, politics, and international crises.
- [US News](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news): United States news including politics, crime, policy, and major events.
- [UK News](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/uk-news): United Kingdom coverage spanning politics, society, and breaking developments.
- [Middle East](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/middle-east): Regional reporting on conflicts, diplomacy, security, and Gulf affairs.
- [Asia News](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/asia-news): Coverage of political, economic, and social developments across Asia.
- [Europe News](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/europe-news): News from Europe on elections, security, economy, and regional affairs.

## City Editions
- [Cities](https://www.hindustantimes.com/cities): Entry point to local reporting from Indian cities and metro regions.
- [Delhi News](https://www.hindustantimes.com/cities/delhi-news): Local coverage of governance, traffic, crime, weather, and civic issues in Delhi.
- [Mumbai News](https://www.hindustantimes.com/cities/mumbai-news): Mumbai reporting on infrastructure, politics, crime, and city life.
- [Bengaluru News](https://www.hindustantimes.com/cities/bengaluru-news): Bengaluru news covering civic affairs, tech city developments, and local events.
- [Lucknow News](https://www.hindustantimes.com/cities/lucknow-news): Regional and city reporting from Lucknow and surrounding areas.
- [Chandigarh News](https://www.hindustantimes.com/cities/chandigarh-news): Chandigarh coverage on administration, education, and local developments.
- [Kolkata News](https://www.hindustantimes.com/cities/kolkata-news): Kolkata city news including politics, transport, culture, and civic updates.
- [Noida News](https://www.hindustantimes.com/cities/noida-news): Noida and NCR reporting on housing, traffic, crime, and urban growth.

## Sports
- [Sports](https://www.hindustantimes.com/sports): Multi-sport coverage including cricket, football, tennis, and major tournaments.
- [Cricket](https://www.hindustantimes.com/cricket): Cricket news, live scores, match reports, series coverage, and player updates.
- [IPL 2025](https://www.hindustantimes.com/cricket/ipl): Indian Premier League coverage with fixtures, reports, and team news.
- [Football](https://www.hindustantimes.com/sports/football): Football reporting on leagues, tournaments, transfers, and match analysis.
- [Tennis](https://www.hindustantimes.com/sports/tennis): Tennis news, Grand Slam coverage, player interviews, and results.
- [Other Sports](https://www.hindustantimes.com/sports/others): Coverage of Olympic sports, athletics, badminton, and more.

## Entertainment and Culture
- [Entertainment](https://www.hindustantimes.com/entertainment): Film, television, celebrity, streaming, and pop culture coverage.
- [Bollywood](https://www.hindustantimes.com/entertainment/bollywood): Hindi film industry news, releases, interviews, and celebrity updates.
- [Hollywood](https://www.hindustantimes.com/entertainment/hollywood): Hollywood news, trailers, awards, and international entertainment reporting.
- [Web Series](https://www.hindustantimes.com/entertainment/web-series): Streaming series coverage, reviews, release updates, and cast news.
- [Music](https://www.hindustantimes.com/entertainment/music): Music industry stories, artist interviews, releases, and concert coverage.
- [TV](https://www.hindustantimes.com/entertainment/tv): Television news, serial updates, reality shows, and cast interviews.
- [HT City](https://www.hindustantimes.com/htcity): Culture, events, food, style, and entertainment features from HT City.

## Business and Technology
- [Business](https://www.hindustantimes.com/business): Markets, economy, companies, policy, and personal finance news.
- [Technology](https://www.hindustantimes.com/technology): Tech news on smartphones, apps, AI, internet trends, and gadgets.
- [Car and Bike](https://www.hindustantimes.com/car-bike): Automobile launches, reviews, EV coverage, and industry developments.
- [Tech Reviews](https://www.hindustantimes.com/technology/reviews): Product reviews for phones, laptops, wearables, and consumer gadgets.
- [Mobile News](https://www.hindustantimes.com/technology/mobile): Smartphone launches, comparisons, software updates, and mobile ecosystem news.
- [Auto News](https://www.hindustantimes.com/car-bike/latest-auto-news): Latest updates from the automotive industry and vehicle market.

## Lifestyle
- [Lifestyle](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle): Features on wellness, relationships, travel, fashion, and everyday living.
- [Health](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/health): Medical guidance, fitness tips, nutrition, and public health reporting.
- [Fashion](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion): Style trends, celebrity fashion, beauty, and designer coverage.
- [Travel](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/travel): Destination guides, travel inspiration, and practical trip planning advice.
- [Relationships](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/relationships): Advice and features on family, dating, and emotional wellbeing.
- [Art and Culture](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/art-culture): Coverage of books, exhibitions, heritage, and cultural events.
- [Brunch](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/brunch): Weekend magazine-style features on culture, food, and personalities.

## Premium, Explainers, and Special Formats
- [HT Premium](https://www.hindustantimes.com/ht-premium): Subscriber-focused analysis, long reads, and exclusive editorial content.
- [Explainers](https://www.hindustantimes.com/topic/explainer): Topic-driven explainers that break down complex news developments.
- [Live Updates](https://www.hindustantimes.com/live-updates): Live blogs tracking fast-moving events, elections, sports, and breaking news.
- [Topic Index](https://www.hindustantimes.com/topic): Browse coverage organized by people, events, issues, and recurring themes.
- [Newsletters](https://www.hindustantimes.com/newsletters): Email newsletter offerings for curated updates across major coverage areas.
- [E-paper](https://www.hindustantimes.com/epaper): Digital newspaper edition replicating the print reading experience.

## Utility and Platform Pages
- [RSS Feeds](https://www.hindustantimes.com/feeds/rss): RSS access for following Hindustan Times content programmatically.
- [Contact Us](https://www.hindustantimes.com/contact-us): Contact information and support channels for readers and inquiries.
- [About Us](https://www.hindustantimes.com/about-us): Background on the publication, editorial mission, and organization.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.hindustantimes.com/privacy-policy): Privacy practices governing data collection, cookies, and user information.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.hindustantimes.com/terms-of-use): Terms governing access to and use of the website and content.
- [Sitemap](https://www.hindustantimes.com/sitemap): Structured index of site sections and published content.
